article_theory_of_war.summary: Security briefs, news reports and study books all use the words of the theory of war. After reading this you can explain Clausewitz's central sentence, tell strategy from operations and tactics, name the five classical elements of a campaign, say what friction and escalation mean, and use the vocabulary of deterrence, attrition and morale in a sentence of your own.
article_theory_of_war.title: The Theory of War: Strategy, Tactics and the Politics Behind It
